title: TechnoHorizon
subtitle: Full-cycle SDLC orchestration, enterprise HRMS suites, high-conversion commercial platforms, and internal engineering ecosystems.

projects.title: ETTM — Employee Task Tracking Manager
projects.shortDesc: End-to-end internal SDLC & workforce operations platform engineered to track the complete software lifecycle — covering Scrum sprints, task assignments, deadline telemetry, and daily punch-in/punch-out attendance.
highlights: Complete SDLC Lifecycle Tracking: Centralizes sprint planning, Scrum meeting logs, granular task allocation, and real-time deadline monitoring across engineering teams.
Attendance & Punch Telemetry: Integrated daily punch-in and punch-out verification workflows correlated directly with active task logs and sprint velocity.
Role-Based Team Governance: Custom permission hierarchies for leads, developers, and project managers to audit deliverables without bottlenecks.

projects.title: AB-HRMS — Enterprise Human Resource Management System
projects.shortDesc: Production-grade Human Resource Management System streamlining employee lifecycle onboarding, payroll computation, leave workflows, and organizational analytics.
highlights: Unified Workforce Operations: Digitizes employee directories, attendance ledgers, leave approvals, and departmental hierarchy management.
Automated Compliance & Reporting: Real-time administrative dashboards and exportable operational reports for HR leadership.
Scalable Multi-Role Architecture: Built from the ground up with clean REST APIs and responsive interfaces for both desktop admins and mobile staff.

projects.title: Eatpur.in — Food & Culinary Commerce Platform
projects.shortDesc: Modern, high-speed digital ordering and brand experience platform crafted with fluid animations, intuitive menu discovery, and mobile-first checkout flows.
highlights: Mobile-First Consumer Experience: Engineered fast-loading catalog browsing and frictionless cart interactions tailored for on-the-go diners.
High-Conversion Visual Polish: Combined crisp typography, appetizing visual hierarchy, and smooth micro-interactions.

projects.title: The Jungle Story (thejunglestory.in)
projects.shortDesc: Immersive digital storefront and booking experience designed to showcase nature-inspired hospitality, curated stays, and visual storytelling.
highlights: Atmospheric Brand Storytelling: Designed rich visual layouts and smooth scroll reveals that reflect the brand's natural aesthetic.
Cross-Device Performance: Optimized media delivery and responsive breakpoints for seamless browsing across mobile, tablet, and desktop.

projects.title: TechnoHorizon Corporate Portal (technohorizon.co.in)
projects.shortDesc: Official corporate web presence for TechnoHorizon Co. Ltd. showcasing enterprise IT capabilities, government digital transformation case studies, and service verticals.
highlights: Executive Brand Positioning: Architected a clean, authoritative corporate interface highlighting both private-sector products and public-sector IT initiatives.
Modular Component System: Engineered reusable UI sections and smooth page transitions for long-term maintainability.
